Scenario fixture: aria-list-item-roles (RGAA 9.3.1, 9.3.2)

Each target list has a stable id of the form alir_case_NN. RGAA accepts <ul>/<ol> with <li>, or role="list" with role="listitem". Whether the content is visually a list, ordered or not, is left to a person, so the rule asks.
